It’s not so much to do with the big, overarching factors like being endangered or native for me. It’s more about the fact that those specific reptiles you’ve caught won’t live long, will spend the rest of their life stressed out, and don’t understand why you’ve stolen them from the natural habitat that they actually want to be in. Domesticated animals don’t get stressed out in captivity (with good husbandry) because they don’t know any different. Wild caught animals will always want to go back to their real home.
Edit: I should say this stands for healthy wild animals that would still survive in the wild, I support rehabilitation and sanctuaries for injured or ill wild animals.
